items.question: Does Reviw block negative reviews from Google?
items.answer: No, Reviw routes them. Customers who rate 4-5 stars get a one-tap link to leave a Google review. Customers who rate 1-3 stars are invited to share feedback privately first, so you can address it before it ever goes public.

items.question: Do I need a credit card to start the free trial?
items.answer: Yes. Both the 7-day Business trial and the 14-day Agency trial require a card to start. You won't be charged until the trial ends, and you can cancel anytime before then.

items.question: Can agencies really resell Reviw under their own brand?
items.answer: Yes. The Agency plan includes a fully white-labeled portal (your own domain, logo, and colors), and client payments go directly to your Stripe account, so you keep 100% of what you charge.

items.question: What languages does Reviw support?
items.answer: Surveys and the dashboard are available in English and Spanish today.

items.question: How is the reputation score calculated?
items.answer: It's a blended 0-10 score combining your live Google rating with the NPS collected from your surveys, weighted by how many responses you've collected.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes, on both plans. There's no long-term contract.

items.question: Do I need development skills to sell this?
items.answer: No. White-labeling is logo, colors, and a custom domain — no code. Clients self-signup on your branded portal and you're managing them from day one.

items.question: Do I really keep 100% of what I charge clients?
items.answer: Yes. Client billing runs through your own Stripe account via Stripe Connect. Reviw never takes a cut — you only pay the flat $67/mo platform fee.

items.question: What happens after 15 clients?
items.answer: Each additional client location is $5/month. There's no hard cap.

items.question: How is this different from an all-in-one platform like GoHighLevel?
items.answer: Reviw does one thing — reputation management — and does it well, at a flat $67/mo with no per-feature add-ons. There's no sprawling CRM to configure before you can sell your first client.

items.question: Is there a contract?
items.answer: No. Month-to-month or annual billing, cancel anytime.

items.question: Can my clients pay without me chasing invoices?
items.answer: Yes. Clients self-checkout on your branded portal, and recurring billing runs automatically through your Stripe account.
